# NR Data
> NR Data provides data products, APIs, and documentation for UK rail network and timetable information.

NR Data is the Network Rail data portal, offering access to operational rail datasets, APIs, onboarding information, and technical documentation for developers and data consumers.

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://nr-data.net/): Main portal for accessing Network Rail data products, APIs, and platform information.
- [Register](https://nr-data.net/register): Create an account to access datasets, APIs, and developer resources.
- [Login](https://nr-data.net/login): Sign in to manage access to Network Rail data services.
- [About](https://nr-data.net/about): Overview of the NR Data platform and its purpose.
- [Contact](https://nr-data.net/contact): Contact information for support and platform-related enquiries.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://nr-data.net/docs): Central documentation index for NR Data services and products.
- [Getting Started Guide](https://nr-data.net/docs/getting-started): Introductory guidance for onboarding and using NR Data services.
- [Authentication](https://nr-data.net/docs/authentication): Explains authentication methods and access requirements for protected services.
- [API Documentation](https://nr-data.net/docs/api): Overview of available APIs and how to consume them.
- [Data Feeds](https://nr-data.net/docs/data-feeds): Documentation for real-time and bulk data feed access.
- [Support](https://nr-data.net/docs/support): Help resources and support guidance for developers and users.

## APIs
- [API Overview](https://nr-data.net/api): Entry point for NR Data API access and reference material.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://nr-data.net/api/openapi): Machine-readable API definition for integration and tooling.
- [API Reference](https://nr-data.net/api/reference): Endpoint-level reference for available API operations.
- [Authentication API](https://nr-data.net/api/auth): Authentication-related endpoints and usage details.
- [Status and Health](https://nr-data.net/api/status): Service status or health information for API consumers.

## Data Products
- [Data Products](https://nr-data.net/data-products): Catalog of available Network Rail datasets and products.
- [Timetable Data](https://nr-data.net/data-products/timetable): Information about timetable-related datasets and access methods.
- [Real-Time Data](https://nr-data.net/data-products/real-time): Operational real-time feeds and related product details.
- [Reference Data](https://nr-data.net/data-products/reference): Static and reference datasets for rail network applications.
- [Historical Data](https://nr-data.net/data-products/historical): Historical datasets available through the platform.

## Developer Resources
- [Developers](https://nr-data.net/developers): Developer-focused resources for integrating with NR Data services.
- [Guides](https://nr-data.net/developers/guides): Practical implementation guides for common integration tasks.
- [Examples](https://nr-data.net/developers/examples): Example usage patterns and sample integrations.
- [SDKs](https://nr-data.net/developers/sdks): Software development kits and client library information.
- [Changelog](https://nr-data.net/developers/changelog): Notable platform and API changes relevant to developers.

## Access and Onboarding
- [Access Requests](https://nr-data.net/access): Information on requesting access to protected datasets and services.
- [Onboarding](https://nr-data.net/access/onboarding): Steps required to begin consuming NR Data products.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://nr-data.net/access/terms): Terms governing use of NR Data services and datasets.
- [Licensing](https://nr-data.net/access/licensing): Licensing information for available data products.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nr-data.net/privacy): Privacy information for platform users.

## Support and Service Information
- [Help Centre](https://nr-data.net/help): General help resources for users of the NR Data platform.
- [FAQ](https://nr-data.net/help/faq): Frequently asked questions about access, products, and usage.
- [Service Status](https://nr-data.net/status): Operational status information for NR Data services.
- [Incident Updates](https://nr-data.net/status/incidents): Information about current or recent service incidents.
- [Support Contact](https://nr-data.net/contact): Contact route for technical and platform support.

## News and Updates
- [News](https://nr-data.net/news): Announcements and updates related to NR Data and its services.
- [Blog](https://nr-data.net/blog): Articles and technical updates for users and developers.
- [Release Notes](https://nr-data.net/releases): Published release notes for platform and API changes.
- [Roadmap](https://nr-data.net/roadmap): Forward-looking information on planned platform improvements.
